scope: Frozen manual source-lowering call inventory; parser and resolution limitations apply.

query_ranking_check.scope: Consequences of reviewed source premises; not a Rust control-flow or native-byte proof.

factory_value_flow_check.sensitivity_without_exhaustive_return_pr: requested query has no result: unknown, not false
factory_value_flow_check.scope: Only the direct Factory match at this producer/consumer return edge; not whole-program acyclicity.

limitations: Not rustc type checking or macro expansion; unresolved calls are retained, not certified absent.
Method-name fallback and unknown external callback invocation are overapproximations and may create false cycles.
Conditional compilation other than exact cfg(test) is retained conservatively. Derive-generated methods and external dependencies are outside parsed bodies.
Function-pointer flows through heap fields, returned closures, complex patterns or trait objects may remain unresolved.
SCCs show possible native call cycles, not source-dependent runtime depth. Manual body/guard/queue classification and exercised 2 MiB boundaries remain necessary.
